name: Pullquote on photo — depth stage
description: A pullquote that BUILDS IN line by line over a moody photo, then holds for reading. The quote reveals reading-order (line-by-line-slide on the title slot: line 1, then line 2 fades up after) — that's the moment; then it holds while a slow camera push parallaxes the near-plane quote against the far-plane photo (dimensional depth, ADR-0028 depth stage). The photo (warm key + bokeh along the top, deep dark through the middle — composed FOR a centred quote) is the full-bleed backdrop, oversized to stay full-bleed across the move; the quote sits pin-sharp in the dark zone (legibility 15:1+, helped by a gentle backdrop contrast-darken). DOF aperture is 0 on purpose — the depth-stage gather bleeds the defocused background into the bright crisp text (a halo), so the bokeh look is BAKED into the substrate and the depth stage earns its keep via the parallax + the text riding the near plane. Substrate is a bundled deterministic in-repo image (atmosphere-warm); backgroundFill is the opaque-lane backstop.

content.title: Build on bedrock. The tide goes out; bedrock stays.
content.author: Scott Tolinski
